able.en: having the power to do something
able.ex: She was able to finish the work early.

access.en: the chance to get or use something
access.ex: Every student should have access to a library.

accessible.ex: The library is accessible to all students.

acclaimed.ex: Her acclaimed film won three awards.

according.ex: According to the report, prices fell last year.

addition.ex: In addition, the bus will stop at the airport.

adult.en: a fully grown animal or person
adult.ex: An adult elephant eats a lot each day.

adultery.en: sex with someone who is not your husband or wife
adultery.ex: Old laws once treated adultery as a crime.

adults.ex: Tickets cost ten dollars for adults.

affected.ex: Many farms were affected by the dry summer.

aim.en: in 'take aim at': attack or criticise
aim.ex: Critics took aim at the new tax.

alike.en: in 'A and B alike': both A and B
alike.ex: Teachers and students alike liked the plan.
alike.zh: 同樣地（A and B alike：A和B都）

almost.ex: It is almost time for dinner.

any.en: one or some, of whatever kind

anywhere.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.

approximately.ex: The trip takes approximately two hours.

archives.en: a place where old official records are kept
archives.ex: Researchers spent weeks in the city archives.
archives.zh: 檔案館（National Archives：國家檔案館）

around.ex: Around fifty people came to the meeting.

as.en: in the role or way of

at.en: in or near a place or time

authors.ex: Two local authors signed books at the shop.

available.en: able to be used or obtained

bad.ex: I'm afraid I have some bad news.

ban.en: an official rule that stops something
ban.ex: The city introduced a ban on smoking in parks.

banned.ex: The school banned phones in class.

be.ex: Try to be kind to others.

become.ex: The town has become very popular.

been.ex: She has been here since morning.

board.en: an official group that makes decisions
board.ex: The board meets once a month.

body.ex: A new body will check the rules.

book.en: a set of printed pages that you read
book.ex: I left my book on the bus.

books.en: things with pages that you read
books.ex: She reads two books every month.

broader.ex: We need to look at the broader picture.

building.en: a structure with walls and a roof
building.ex: The office building has ten floors.

by.en: showing amount of change; done by

call.ex: Call me when you get home.

called.ex: A shop called Bloom sells flowers.

can.ex: You can find good jobs in the city.

cast.en: in 'cast the net wider': include more things
cast.ex: Police cast their net wider to find witnesses.
cast.zh: cast the net wider：撒網更廣，擴大範圍

catch-all.en: a word that covers many different things
catch-all.ex: 'Stress' became a catch-all for many problems.

censor.en: someone who decides what people may read or see
censor.ex: The film censor cut two scenes.

censored.en: officially stopped or cut because seen as unacceptable
censored.ex: The newspaper report was censored by the army.

censors.en: people who decide what may be published
censors.ex: The censors removed every mention of the war.

censorship.en: official control of what people may read or see
censorship.ex: The writers protested against press censorship.

example.en: The government ended press censorship in 1990.
example.zh: 政府在1990年結束了新聞審查。

note.meaning: 審查制度；官方對出版或言論內容的管制。
note.usage: 常見 press/state censorship；impose censorship；也可說 the scope of censorship。

noteEn.meaning: official control over what people can read or see.

noteEs.exampleTr: El gobierno puso fin a la censura de prensa en 1990.
noteEs.meaning: control oficial de lo que se publica; censura.
noteEs.usage: Se usa state/press censorship, impose censorship.

noteHi.exampleTr: सरकार ने 1990 में प्रेस सेंसरशिप खत्म की।
noteHi.meaning: सरकार द्वारा प्रकाशनों पर नियंत्रण; सेंसरशिप।
noteHi.usage: state/press censorship, impose censorship आम प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: 政府は1990年に報道検閲を廃止した。
noteJa.meaning: 出版物や言論に対する公的な規制；検閲。
noteJa.usage: state/press censorship、impose censorship の形でよく使う。

noteKo.usage: state/press censorship, impose censorship 형태가 흔하다.

classify.en: to put into an official group or type
classify.ex: Scientists classify the plants by their leaves.

collection.en: a group of things kept together
collection.ex: The museum has a large collection of maps.

college.en: a place to study after school
college.ex: She wants to study art at college.

confined.ex: The problem is not confined to Dublin.

consequently.ex: It rained all day; consequently, the match was cancelled.

considerably.ex: Prices are considerably higher in the city.

considered.ex: The plan must be considered carefully.

consultation.ex: The old maps are available for consultation.

content.en: what is written or shown in something

convened.en: came together for a formal meeting
convened.ex: The committee convened to discuss the budget.

course.en: in 'in due course': at the right time later
course.es: (in due course) a su debido tiempo
course.ex: You will hear from us in due course.

covers.en: the outside front parts of books

curiosity.en: something strange or interesting, but not important now
curiosity.ex: The old phone is now a museum curiosity.

date.en: in 'out of date': old-fashioned, no longer useful
date.ex: This map is out of date.

dealing.ex: She is good at dealing with complaints.

debut.ex: The singer made her debut in 2020.

decades.ex: The house has stood empty for decades.

decide.ex: We must decide where to go.

decided.ex: We decided to stay at home.

decision.ex: The court made a fair decision.

deemed.ex: The water was deemed safe to drink.

department.en: a part of a government or organisation
department.ex: He works in the health department.

depictions.en: ways something is shown in words or pictures
depictions.ex: The book has vivid depictions of village life.

example.en: The film's depiction of war is very realistic.
example.zh: 這部電影對戰爭的描寫非常寫實。

note.usage: 常見 depiction of sth；realistic/accurate depiction。

noteEn.meaning: a way of showing something in words or pictures.

noteEs.exampleTr: La representación de la guerra en la película es muy realista.
noteEs.meaning: forma de mostrar algo en palabras o imágenes.
noteEs.usage: Se usa depiction of something; realistic depiction.

noteHi.exampleTr: फ़िल्म में युद्ध का चित्रण बहुत यथार्थवादी है।
noteHi.meaning: शब्दों या चित्रों में किसी चीज़ को दिखाना; चित्रण।
noteHi.usage: depiction of sth, realistic depiction आम प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: その映画の戦争描写はとても写実的だ。
noteJa.meaning: 言葉や絵で表すこと；描写。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 영화의 전쟁 묘사는 매우 사실적이다.

distinguished.ex: A distinguished scientist gave the opening speech.

distributed.en: given or sent out to many
distributed.ex: Leaflets were distributed in the street.

divorce.en: the legal end of a marriage
divorce.ex: Divorce became legal in Ireland in 1996.

due.ex: The report is due next week.

empowered.en: given official power to do something
empowered.ex: Inspectors are empowered to close unsafe shops.

example.en: The council is empowered to fine polluters.
example.zh: 市議會有權對污染者罰款。

note.usage: 常用 be empowered to do sth；也指使人更有自信（empower women）。

noteEs.exampleTr: El ayuntamiento está facultado para multar a quienes contaminan.
noteEs.usage: Se usa be empowered to do something.

noteHi.exampleTr: परिषद को प्रदूषकों पर जुर्माना लगाने का अधिकार है।
noteHi.usage: be empowered to do sth आम रूप है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 議会は汚染者に罰金を科す権限がある。
noteJa.usage: be empowered to do の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 의회는 오염 유발자에게 벌금을 물릴 권한이 있다.
noteKo.usage: be empowered to do 형태로 자주 쓴다.

encompasses.ex: The park encompasses forests, lakes and hills.

example.en: The course encompasses history, art and music.
example.zh: 這門課程涵蓋歷史、藝術和音樂。

note.usage: 比 include 正式，強調範圍廣：encompass a wide range of。

noteEn.usage: More formal than 'include': 'encompass a wide range'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El curso abarca historia, arte y música.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que include; encompass a wide range of.

noteHi.exampleTr: पाठ्यक्रम में इतिहास, कला और संगीत शामिल हैं।
noteHi.usage: include से औपचारिक; encompass a wide range of।

noteJa.exampleTr: その講座は歴史、芸術、音楽を網羅している。
noteJa.usage: include より硬く、範囲の広さを強調。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 과정은 역사, 예술, 음악을 아우른다.
noteKo.usage: include보다 격식 있고 범위의 넓음을 강조.

era.en: a long period of time in history
era.ex: We live in an era of fast change.

essentially.en: basically; in the most important way
essentially.ex: The two phones are essentially the same.

established.ex: The law established a new agency.

even.en: used to show something is surprising
even.ex: Even a little rain can make roads slippery.

eventually.en: in the end; after some time
eventually.ex: We eventually found the right road.

explains.ex: The teacher explains the rules slowly.

extending.en: making something last longer or reach more people
extending.ex: The city is extending bus services to the suburbs.

f.en: a letter used as a short first name

fallen.en: in 'fallen foul of': got into trouble with
fallen.ex: The shop had fallen foul of health rules.

far.ex: The trip took far longer than planned.

figures.ex: Leading figures from the arts attended.

final.ex: The final decision is next week.

finally.ex: The rain finally stopped at midnight.

first.ex: It was her first trip to Ireland.

for.en: used to show purpose or time

formerly.ex: The hotel was formerly a hospital.

foul.en: in 'fall foul of': get into trouble with
foul.ex: The firm fell foul of new safety rules.

function.en: the job or purpose of something
function.ex: The main function of the office is planning.

future.ex: Future students will benefit from the change.

general.ex: The museum is open to the general public.

generally.ex: Trains are generally on time here.

girls.ex: The girls played football after school.

go.ex: Most teens go online every day.

green.en: part of the name of a Dublin park
green.zh: Green（St Stephen's Green：聖史蒂芬綠地）

group.en: a number of people or things together
group.ex: A group of students visited the museum.

had.en: helping verb for past perfect; possessed
had.zh: 已經（過去完成助動詞）；有

handed.en: given to someone else to keep
handed.ex: The keys were handed over to the new owner.

has.ex: She has lived here for years.

have.ex: They have worked here for ten years.

heritage.en: old buildings and traditions valued as part of history
heritage.ex: Music is part of Irish heritage.

historical.ex: The city is tackling historical problems with traffic.

history.ex: The town has a long history.

hitherto.ex: Hitherto, the files had been secret.

example.en: The letters reveal hitherto unknown facts about her life.
example.zh: 這些信件揭露了她生平中迄今未知的事實。

note.usage: 正式書面語，常放句首或接形容詞：hitherto unknown/unseen。

noteEn.usage: Formal; often 'hitherto unknown' or at the start of a sentence.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las cartas revelan datos hasta ahora desconocidos de su vida.

noteHi.exampleTr: पत्र उसके जीवन के अब तक अज्ञात तथ्य बताते हैं।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक; hitherto unknown/unseen रूप में आम।

noteJa.exampleTr: 手紙は彼女の人生のこれまで知られていなかった事実を明らかにする。
noteJa.usage: 硬い書き言葉。hitherto unknown のように形容詞の前に置く。

noteKo.exampleTr: 편지들은 그녀 삶의 지금까지 알려지지 않은 사실을 드러낸다.
noteKo.usage: 격식 있는 문어; hitherto unknown처럼 형용사 앞에 자주 쓴다.

hoard.en: a large hidden or stored collection
hoard.ex: A hoard of old coins was found in a field.

however.ex: It was sunny; however, it was cold.

inaccessible.en: not possible to reach or use
inaccessible.ex: The village was inaccessible after the flood.

example.en: The island is inaccessible in winter.

note.usage: 常用 inaccessible to sb；remain inaccessible；反義 accessible。

noteEn.meaning: not possible to reach, enter or use.

noteEs.exampleTr: La isla es inaccesible en invierno.
noteEs.usage: Se usa inaccessible to someone; remain inaccessible.

noteHi.exampleTr: सर्दियों में द्वीप तक पहुँचना संभव नहीं।
noteHi.meaning: जहाँ पहुँचना या जिसे पाना संभव नहीं।
noteHi.usage: inaccessible to sb, remain inaccessible आम प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: その島は冬は行くことができない。
noteJa.meaning: 近づけない；利用できない。
noteJa.usage: inaccessible to 人、remain inaccessible の形。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 섬은 겨울에 갈 수 없다.
noteKo.usage: inaccessible to 사람, remain inaccessible 형태.

include.en: have as a part or member
include.ex: The team includes two new players.

indecent.ex: The magazine was judged indecent by the court.

inside.ex: Life inside the company is changing.

institution.en: a large organisation such as a hospital
institution.ex: The university is a respected institution.

intends.ex: We intend to open a new branch.

internationally.en: in other countries; around the world

internet.ex: I found the recipe on the internet.

judge.en: to decide what you think about something
judge.ex: It is hard to judge a book by its title.

jurisdiction.en: the area where a legal system has power
jurisdiction.ex: The case falls outside this court's jurisdiction.

example.en: The crime happened outside the court's jurisdiction.
example.zh: 這起犯罪發生在該法院的管轄範圍之外。

note.meaning: 司法管轄區；法律權力所及的範圍。
note.usage: 常見 within/outside the jurisdiction；fall under the jurisdiction of。

noteEn.meaning: the area where a legal system has power.

noteEs.exampleTr: El delito ocurrió fuera de la jurisdicción del tribunal.
noteEs.meaning: territorio donde un sistema legal tiene poder.

noteHi.exampleTr: अपराध अदालत के क्षेत्राधिकार के बाहर हुआ।
noteHi.meaning: वह क्षेत्र जहाँ कोई कानून या अदालत लागू होती है।

noteJa.exampleTr: その犯罪は裁判所の管轄外で起きた。
noteJa.meaning: 法律や裁判所の権限が及ぶ範囲；管轄。
noteJa.usage: within/outside the jurisdiction の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 범죄는 법원의 관할 밖에서 일어났다.
noteKo.meaning: 법이나 법원의 권한이 미치는 범위; 관할.

justice.ex: The Department of Justice owns the building.

kept.ex: Animals kept in zoos need exercise.

label.en: a word used to describe someone or something

languished.en: stayed without progress for a long time
languished.ex: The plan has languished for years.

last.ex: The last train leaves at midnight.

lawfully.en: in a way the law allows
lawfully.ex: Only licensed shops may lawfully sell alcohol.

lecturer.en: a teacher at a university or college
lecturer.ex: The lecturer answered questions after class.

legally.ex: Drivers are legally required to wear belts.

limits.en: in 'off limits': not allowed to enter or use
limits.ex: The roof is off limits to students.

list.en: a set of names written one after another
list.ex: Her name is on the guest list.

literary.ex: Dublin has a rich literary history.

little.ex: We had little time to think.

locked.ex: The papers were in a locked drawer.

look.ex: The board will look at the plan again.

lurid.en: shocking and too bright or detailed
lurid.ex: The paper printed a lurid headline.

majority.en: more than half of a group
majority.ex: The majority of students passed the test.

make.ex: The change will make life easier.

marking.ex: The win marks his tenth title.

meant.ex: The money is meant to help families.

mention.es: (not to mention) por no hablar de
mention.ex: She speaks French, not to mention German.

met.ex: The ministers met for two hours.

more.ex: This test is more difficult than the last one.

move.ex: The office will move to Cork next year.

nation's.ex: It is the nation's top show.

national.ex: There will be a national holiday.

net.en: a wide range; (cast the net wider) include more
net.ex: The search used a wide net.
net.zh: 網（cast the net wider：擴大範圍）

nevertheless.ex: The test was hard; nevertheless, she passed.

nonetheless.ex: The task was hard; nonetheless, she finished it.

not.en: used to make a sentence negative
not.ex: Please do not run in the hall.

notably.ex: Notably, sales rose during the winter.

notes.ex: The report notes a rise in crime.

novel.ex: She is reading a new novel.

novels.ex: He has written four novels about Dublin.

obscene.en: offensive in a shocking way, often about sex
obscene.ex: The court banned the obscene film.

obscurity.ex: The singer rose from obscurity to fame.

observes.ex: She observes that the town has changed.

obsolete.ex: Fax machines are almost obsolete now.

example.en: Smartphones made paper maps almost obsolete.
example.zh: 智慧型手機讓紙本地圖幾乎被淘汰。

note.meaning: 過時的；已不再使用或不需要的。

noteEs.exampleTr: Los móviles dejaron los mapas de papel casi obsoletos.
noteEs.meaning: que ya no se usa o no hace falta; obsoleto.

noteHi.exampleTr: स्मार्टफ़ोन ने कागज़ी नक्शों को लगभग अप्रचलित कर दिया।
noteHi.meaning: अब ज़रूरी या प्रयोग में नहीं; अप्रचलित।

noteJa.exampleTr: スマートフォンで紙の地図はほぼ時代遅れになった。
noteJa.meaning: もう使われない、必要ない；時代遅れの。

noteKo.exampleTr: 스마트폰 때문에 종이 지도는 거의 쓸모없어졌다.
noteKo.meaning: 더 이상 쓰이지 않거나 필요 없는; 구식의.

off.ex: They called off the match because of rain.

online.ex: Teenagers spend hours online every day.

open.en: to let people see or use
open.ex: The museum will open the archive next year.

opened.en: started working for the first time

ordinary.ex: It looks like an ordinary house.

out.en: in 'out of date': no longer current
out.ex: His phone is out of date.

outlaw.ex: The city plans to outlaw cars in the centre.

over.en: in 'handed over': given to someone else
over.ex: She handed the job over to her assistant.

paperback.en: a book with a soft paper cover
paperback.ex: I bought a cheap paperback at the airport.

plans.ex: The town has plans for a new park.

poised.ex: The team is poised to win the cup.

portrayals.en: ways a person or thing is shown
portrayals.ex: The film gives honest portrayals of farm life.

powers.ex: Police have new powers to stop cars.

note.usage: 比 mainly 正式；常修飾形容詞或動詞：predominantly rural/female。

noteEs.usage: Más formal que mainly; predominantly rural/young.

noteHi.exampleTr: दर्शक मुख्य रूप से युवा थे।
noteHi.usage: mainly से अधिक औपचारिक; predominantly rural/young।

noteJa.exampleTr: 観客は主に若者だった。
noteJa.usage: mainly より硬い。predominantly young などの形。

noteKo.usage: mainly보다 격식 있음; predominantly young 등.

preservation.en: keeping something safe from harm or loss
preservation.ex: The group works for the preservation of old buildings.

example.en: The town spends a lot on the preservation of its castle.
example.zh: 這座城鎮花很多錢保存它的城堡。

note.meaning: 保存；保護使其不受損失。
note.usage: 常見 the preservation of heritage/the environment；preservation order。

noteEn.meaning: keeping something safe so it is not lost.

noteEs.exampleTr: El pueblo gasta mucho en la conservación de su castillo.
noteEs.usage: Se usa the preservation of heritage.

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर अपने किले के संरक्षण पर बहुत खर्च करता है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को सुरक्षित रखना; संरक्षण।
noteHi.usage: the preservation of heritage आम प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: 町は城の保存に多くの費用をかけている。
noteJa.meaning: 損なわれないよう守ること；保存。
noteJa.usage: the preservation of heritage の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 마을은 성을 보존하는 데 많은 돈을 쓴다.
noteKo.usage: the preservation of heritage 형태가 흔하다.

prohibited.ex: Smoking is prohibited in the building.

proscribed.ex: The drug is proscribed in most countries.

example.en: Such weapons are proscribed by international law.
example.zh: 這類武器受國際法禁止。

note.usage: 正式、書面用語，常見被動 be proscribed by law；比 ban 更正式。

noteEs.exampleTr: Esas armas están prohibidas por el derecho internacional.
noteEs.usage: Muy formal; a menudo en pasiva: be proscribed by law.

noteHi.exampleTr: ऐसे हथियार अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून द्वारा प्रतिबंधित हैं।
noteHi.usage: बहुत औपचारिक; अक्सर be proscribed by law रूप में।

noteJa.exampleTr: そうした兵器は国際法で禁止されている。
noteJa.usage: ban より硬い語。be proscribed by law の受け身が多い。

noteKo.usage: ban보다 격식 있는 말; be proscribed by law 수동형이 흔하다.

public.ex: The park is open to the public.

publications.en: books, magazines and other printed works
publications.ex: The library keeps all local publications.

publicly.ex: The results will be publicly available soon.

ranging.en: covering a range between two points
ranging.ex: We sell shoes ranging from small to very large.

read.en: look at words and understand them
read.ex: He likes to read before bed.

readers.ex: The magazine has many young readers.

reading.en: looking at words and understanding them
reading.ex: She enjoys reading in the garden.

referred.ex: The word referred to anything rude.

regarded.en: thought of in a particular way
regarded.ex: He is regarded as the best player on the team.

relating.ex: The data relating to August is final.

renowned.ex: The town is renowned for its music festival.

example.en: Kerry is renowned for its beautiful coast.
example.zh: 凱里郡以美麗的海岸聞名。

note.usage: 常見 renowned for sth；world-renowned；internationally renowned。

noteEs.exampleTr: Kerry es famoso por su hermosa costa.
noteEs.usage: Se usa renowned for; internationally renowned.

noteHi.exampleTr: केरी अपने सुंदर तट के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
noteHi.usage: renowned for, internationally renowned आम प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: ケリーは美しい海岸で有名だ。

role.ex: He has a key role in the team.

roll.en: in 'roll call': a list of names
roll.ex: The roll call of guests was impressive.

room.en: a space inside a building with walls
room.ex: The meeting is in room four.

says.ex: He says the shop is closed.

scheduled.ex: The flight is scheduled for noon.

scope.en: the range of things something deals with

paragraphs: For many years, Ireland stopped people from reading some books. A State group called the Censorship of Publications Board decided which books were bad. It started in 1930.
About 12,000 of these banned books are in a room in Dublin. The room is in a Department of Justice building on St Stephen's Green. The public could not see them.
Now the books will move to the National Archives later this year. In the future, people will be able to look at them.
Some famous writers are on the list. They include Ernest Hemingway, F Scott Fitzgerald and the Irish writer Edna O'Brien.

A history teacher says the board often banned books about sex. It also banned books about divorce and crime. The board last banned a book in 2016. Today, almost everyone can read anything on the internet.
sentZh: 多年來，愛爾蘭禁止人們閱讀某些書。
一個名為「出版物審查委員會」的國家機構決定哪些書是不好的。
它成立於1930年。
這些禁書中約有一萬兩千本放在都柏林的一個房間裡。
這個房間位於聖史蒂芬綠地的一棟司法部大樓內。
民眾以前看不到這些書。
現在，這些書將在今年稍晚移到國家檔案館。
將來，人們將可以看到它們。
名單上有一些知名作家。
其中包括海明威、費茲傑羅以及愛爾蘭作家艾德娜·歐布萊恩。
一位歷史老師說，該委員會常常禁止與性有關的書。
它也禁止關於離婚和犯罪的書。
委員會最後一次禁書是在2016年。
如今，幾乎每個人都能在網路上讀到任何東西。

paragraphs: Thousands of books that the Irish State once banned will soon be available for the public to see. For decades, about 12,000 of them have been kept in a locked room in the Department of Justice building on St Stephen's Green in Dublin.
The books were banned by the Censorship of Publications Board, which was set up in 1930. The board could decide that a book was "indecent" or "obscene", and then it could not be sold in Ireland.
Later this year, the collection will move to the National Archives. After that, it will slowly be opened to the public.
The banned list includes many well-known writers, such as Ernest Hemingway, F Scott Fitzgerald, Iris Murdoch and John Updike. Edna O'Brien's first novel, The Country Girls, was also banned.

Brian Hughes, a history lecturer in Limerick, explains that "indecent" usually meant anything about sex. However, books about divorce, adultery and violent crime were banned too. The board banned its last book in 2016, and today its role is seen as out of date because almost every adult can go online.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭政府曾經禁止的數千本書，很快就能供大眾觀看。
數十年來，其中約一萬兩千本一直被鎖在都柏林聖史蒂芬綠地司法部大樓的一個房間裡。
這些書是被1930年成立的出版物審查委員會所禁。
該委員會可以判定一本書「有傷風化」或「淫穢」，之後這本書就不能在愛爾蘭販售。
今年稍晚，這批藏書將移交國家檔案館。
之後，它將逐步向大眾開放。
禁書名單包括許多知名作家，例如海明威、費茲傑羅、艾瑞絲·梅鐸和約翰·厄普代克。
艾德娜·歐布萊恩的第一本小說《鄉下女孩》也曾被禁。
利默里克的歷史講師布萊恩·休斯解釋說，「有傷風化」通常指任何與性有關的內容。
不過，關於離婚、通姦和暴力犯罪的書也同樣被禁。
該委員會在2016年禁了最後一本書，如今它的角色被視為過時，因為幾乎每個成年人都能上網。

paragraphs: Around 12,000 books once banned by the Irish State are set to be made available to the public for the first time. The collection has spent decades in a room inside the Department of Justice building on St Stephen's Green, where ordinary readers had no access to it.

The titles were prohibited by the Censorship of Publications Board, established in 1930 to judge whether publications were "indecent" or "obscene". Once a book was banned, it could not legally be sold in the country.

Later this year the books will be transferred to the National Archives, which plans to open them to the public in time. Among the banned authors are F Scott Fitzgerald, Ernest Hemingway, Nancy Mitford, Iris Murdoch and John Updike, as well as Edna O'Brien, whose debut novel The Country Girls was censored.

According to Brian Hughes, a history lecturer at Mary Immaculate College in Limerick, the label "indecent" generally covered anything to do with sex. Yet the censors also targeted books dealing with divorce, adultery and violent crime, and even novels with sensational covers.
The board met to ban a book for the last time in 2016. With almost every adult now able to read virtually anything online, the State's role as censor is widely regarded as obsolete.
sentZh: 約一萬兩千本曾遭愛爾蘭政府禁止的書，即將首度向大眾開放。
這批藏書數十年來都放在聖史蒂芬綠地司法部大樓內的一個房間裡，一般讀者無法接觸。
這些書是被出版物審查委員會所禁，該會於1930年成立，負責判斷出版品是否「有傷風化」或「淫穢」。
一本書一旦被禁，就不能在國內合法販售。
今年稍晚，這些書將移交國家檔案館，該館計畫日後將其開放給大眾。
被禁的作者包括費茲傑羅、海明威、南西·米特福德、艾瑞絲·梅鐸和約翰·厄普代克，還有艾德娜·歐布萊恩，她的處女作《鄉下女孩》曾遭審查。
利默里克瑪麗無玷學院的歷史講師布萊恩·休斯表示，「有傷風化」這個標籤通常涵蓋任何與性有關的內容。
然而，審查者也針對探討離婚、通姦和暴力犯罪的書，甚至連封面聳動的小說也不放過。
該委員會最後一次開會禁書是在2016年。
如今幾乎每個成年人都能在網路上讀到幾乎任何內容，國家扮演審查者的角色普遍被認為已經過時。

paragraphs: A trove of some 12,000 books once deemed unfit for Irish readers is finally poised to emerge from obscurity. For decades the volumes have languished in a room within the Department of Justice building on St Stephen's Green, entirely off limits to the public.

Each title had fallen foul of the Censorship of Publications Board, a body set up in 1930 with sweeping powers to outlaw works it considered "indecent" or "obscene". A ban meant a book could not be lawfully sold anywhere in the State.

Later this year the hoard will be handed over to the National Archives, which intends to make it accessible in due course. The roll call of censored authors is strikingly distinguished, ranging from F Scott Fitzgerald and Ernest Hemingway to Nancy Mitford, Iris Murdoch and John Updike, not to mention Edna O'Brien, whose acclaimed debut The Country Girls was suppressed.

Brian Hughes, a history lecturer at Mary Immaculate College in Limerick, notes that "indecent" was essentially a catch-all for anything touching on sex. Nonetheless, the censors cast their net far wider, taking aim at portrayals of divorce, adultery and violent crime, as well as lurid paperback covers.

The board convened to ban a book for the final time in 2016. In an era when virtually any text can be summoned online in seconds, the State's censorship role has become little more than a historical curiosity.
sentZh: 一批約一萬兩千本、曾被認為不適合愛爾蘭讀者的書，終於即將重見天日。
數十年來，這些書一直被冷落在聖史蒂芬綠地司法部大樓內的一個房間裡，完全禁止公眾進入。
每一本書都曾觸犯出版物審查委員會，這個機構於1930年成立，擁有廣泛權力，可將它認為「有傷風化」或「淫穢」的作品列為非法。
一旦被禁，書就不能在國內任何地方合法販售。
今年稍晚，這批藏書將移交國家檔案館，該館打算在適當時候開放查閱。
遭審查的作者名單星光熠熠，從費茲傑羅、海明威到南西·米特福德、艾瑞絲·梅鐸和約翰·厄普代克，更別提艾德娜·歐布萊恩，她備受讚譽的處女作《鄉下女孩》曾遭查禁。
利默里克瑪麗無玷學院的歷史講師布萊恩·休斯指出，「有傷風化」基本上是任何涉及性的內容的總稱。
儘管如此，審查者撒下的網遠比這更廣，矛頭也指向對離婚、通姦和暴力犯罪的描寫，以及聳動的平裝本封面。
該委員會最後一次召開會議禁書是在2016年。
在幾乎任何文字都能在幾秒內於網路上調出的時代，國家的審查角色已不過是一段歷史奇聞。

paragraphs: Approximately 12,000 books formerly prohibited by the Irish State are scheduled to become publicly accessible, marking a significant shift in the preservation of the nation's literary heritage. Hitherto, the collection has been confined to a single room in the Department of Justice building on St Stephen's Green, inaccessible to researchers and the general public alike.

These works were proscribed by the Censorship of Publications Board, an institution established in 1930 and empowered to classify publications as "indecent" or "obscene". Consequently, any book subject to a ban could not legally be distributed within the jurisdiction.

Later this year, the collection is due to be transferred to the National Archives, where it will eventually be made available for consultation. Notably, the list of affected authors encompasses internationally renowned figures such as F Scott Fitzgerald, Ernest Hemingway, Nancy Mitford, Iris Murdoch and John Updike, in addition to Edna O'Brien, whose debut novel The Country Girls was censored.

Brian Hughes, a history lecturer at Mary Immaculate College in Limerick, observes that the term "indecent" predominantly referred to any content relating to sex. Nevertheless, the scope of censorship was considerably broader, extending to depictions of divorce, adultery and violent crime.

The board's final decision to ban a book was made in 2016. Given that the overwhelming majority of adults now have unrestricted internet access, the State's censorship function is widely regarded as obsolete.
sentZh: 約一萬兩千本昔日遭愛爾蘭政府禁止的書預定將向公眾開放，象徵國家文學遺產保存方式的重大轉變。
迄今為止，這批藏書一直被限制在聖史蒂芬綠地司法部大樓的單一房間內，研究人員和一般大眾都無法接觸。
這些作品遭到出版物審查委員會查禁，該機構成立於1930年，有權將出版品歸類為「有傷風化」或「淫穢」。
因此，任何遭禁的書都不得在該司法管轄區內合法流通。
今年稍晚，這批藏書預定移交國家檔案館，最終將開放供人查閱。
值得注意的是，受影響的作者名單涵蓋國際知名人物，例如費茲傑羅、海明威、南西·米特福德、艾瑞絲·梅鐸和約翰·厄普代克，此外還有艾德娜·歐布萊恩，她的處女作《鄉下女孩》曾遭審查。
利默里克瑪麗無玷學院的歷史講師布萊恩·休斯觀察到，「有傷風化」一詞主要指任何與性相關的內容。
然而，審查的範圍其實廣泛得多，延伸到對離婚、通姦和暴力犯罪的描寫。
該委員會最後一次決定禁書是在2016年。
鑑於如今絕大多數成年人都能不受限制地上網，國家的審查職能普遍被認為已經過時。
